name: Venn
description: Dual Euclidean layers + boolean logic; scale-aware melody via Extent

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — F0 pulses A · F1 pulses B (density; absolute pulse count, Bjorklund redistributes)
Alt (Shift) — F0 Extent (scale-degree span 0–24 from Note A) · F1 Interval (0–12 diatonic steps above the line for Ch2)
Third (Btn1 or Btn2 hold) — F0 length A · F1 length B (2–32; independent)
Rotation fixed at 0 (slots freed for Extent / Interval)

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Btn1 or Btn2 hold — Third (length A/B on F0/F1)
Btn2 tap (no fader move) — Mute both outs
Shift+Btn1 — Cycle Logic OR → AND → XOR → Accnt
Shift+Btn2 — Toggle post-logic invert (shadow); white↔none fade like Heat Pump

sections.heading: Melody / LEDs
items: Note A (config) = degree 0 of the device quantizer key; Length-A walks an arch through 0…Extent scale degrees; Ch2 = same line + diatonic Interval
Extent 0 = monotone Note A; higher = wider arch through the A cycle (device key)
Division (note values), GATE %, Prob %, Humanize (Vel jitter; 0 = fixed max), MIDI CH / Note A / Interval B / Out, Color
Color = App Color on Btn1; Btn0 = Logic hue; Top A/B = App Color / complement (layer hits)
Main Btn: logic / app color · density bright · soft hit dip
Alt: Top+Btn dim→sat ∝ Extent / Interval (fixed hues) · Third: shortest hue btn→complement ∝ length
Top flashes = layer hits (Main) · Bottom flashes = logic outs (Main)
Jack0 = logic result + melodic line · Jack1 coupled (OR→∩, AND→△, XOR→∩, Accnt→accent) + Interval

channels.jackDescription: Gate + scale-aware melodic MIDI (Note A + degree arch) for the primary boolean result
channels.faderDescription: Number of pulses in Euclidean layer A (density)
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Scale-degree span above Note A (0–24 degrees, device key)
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Cycle length for layer A and melody phase (2–32)
channels.fnDescription: Hold for length; Shift+tap cycles OR→AND→XOR→Accnt
channels.ledTop: Layer A hits / extent meter / length hue (btn→complement)

channels.jackDescription: Secondary gate + same melodic line + diatonic Interval
channels.faderDescription: Number of pulses in Euclidean layer B (density)
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: Diatonic steps above the melodic line for Ch2 (0–12)
channels.fnDescription: Tap mute both; Shift+tap toggles post-logic invert
channels.ledTop: Layer B complement hits / interval meter / length hue
channels.ledBottom: Coupled with logic meters / length hue
